testcase.name: Scenario: Undock from a pinned expanded panel and redock at the top: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-docking-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:220:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Undock from a pinned expanded panel and redock at the top ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active with the full 3D Model ribbon docked at the top ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and pinned ✔ When the user chooses Undock Ribbon from its title context menu ✔ Then the additional command area closes ✔ And the ribbon floats vertically over the workspace ✔ When the user docks the floating ribbon at the top ✔ Then the full ribbon returns to the top ✔ And the Modify additional command area is closed ✔ When the user opens Modify and clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the additional command area closes
